## VAILABLE — required human review
- [ ] A human independent of the AI author reviewed the complete diff.
- [ ] No private documents, credentials, PII, secrets or proprietary algorithms in code or prompts.
- [ ] Offline confidentiality, Gitleaks, pinned-dependency and CI security checks passed.
- [ ] Package sources, owners, licenses, typo/confusion risks and transitive advisories reviewed.
- [ ] Real output, browser, failure and cleanup tests passed; none were bypassed.
- [ ] Worker isolation, resource limits and deployment permissions reviewed.
- [ ] Agent has no production secrets, direct deployment authority, or merge privileges.
- [ ] Remaining risks recorded and accepted by an authorized reviewer.

Leave as draft until security checks and required independent approval pass.
